units.name: Reset
units.summary: Disable rendering and interrupts, wait for two vblanks, initialize stack/APU state, then run the title/attract/game cycle. Fixed NROM execution view: banks 0,1,2,3 throughout.

units.name: RestartTitleCycle
units.summary: Reset audio, scores and display state before the title screen. Preserve the selected mode while the attract demonstration runs.

units.name: StartSelectedGame
units.summary: Stop the title/demo audio and clear demo mode; this entry is also reached by unwinding the title wait's return address.

units.name: InitializeGame
units.summary: Initialize the selected skill/mode, palettes and half counter, then enter play setup. This is a long-lived control entry, not an isolated returning initializer.

units.name: InitializeHalf
units.summary: Load skill-dependent time/AI settings, field tiles and palette; choose the active side from mode and half parity.

units.name: InitializePlay
units.summary: Clear per-play state, establish ball/field origin, build player records and begin the kickoff sequence. Sentinels use $FF; zero often means an inactive counter.

units.name: WaitKickoffMusic
units.summary: Wait with NMI enabled until the primary audio stream finishes. NMI owns simulation while the foreground waits.

units.name: WaitKickoffResult
units.summary: Run random/proximity/steering preparation while NMI advances play; wait for the result byte, then stop NMI for transition work.

units.name: CheckHalfCompletion
units.summary: Test the match clock at a dead-ball boundary. A completed half can unwind directly into half/game transition; an active half returns carry clear.

units.name: BeginNextPlay
units.summary: Recompute the next field target and restart normal play setup after the kickoff path.

units.name: ResetDownState
units.summary: Clear movement/possession state and rebuild down, field and marker bookkeeping before arranging the next formation.

units.name: ChooseDownTransition
units.summary: Select the punt/change-of-side presentation from result flags and down/field progress; otherwise retain the current possession.

units.name: WaitFormationTransition
units.summary: Wait for the NMI transition result, then rebuild the formation and receiver selection.

units.name: WaitPlayMusic
units.summary: Wait for the audio cue while continuing collision/steering work, then expose the live-ball state.

units.name: WaitLivePlayResult
units.summary: Run proximity and steering updates until one of the $E8 end-of-play result bits is set.

units.name: AdvanceDown
units.summary: Increment the down counter, blank rendering, and check whether the half has expired before another play.

units.name: FinishGameOrDemo
units.summary: Demo mode returns to its caller; a normal completed game builds the result presentation and returns to the title cycle.

units.name: InitializeKickPlay
units.summary: Set the alternate kick state, clear transient actors, and run its formation/selection/result loop. The exact distinction between kick types remains tentative.

units.name: WaitKickPlayMusic
units.summary: Await the primary cue before live kick processing.

units.name: WaitKickResult
units.summary: Continue steering/proximity work until a kick/end-of-play result appears; resume down or play setup from the clock/result state.

units.name: SetNextFieldTarget
units.summary: Add 24 field units to the ball's longitudinal coordinate and return the 16-bit target in NextTargetLo/Hi.

units.name: DrawHalfModeText
units.summary: Select one of two half labels by parity and copy its FF-terminated tile string to nametable $2B48.

units.name: DrawSkillAndHalf
units.summary: Clamp skill/half index for its text table, draw the skill name at $2B08, and draw the half label at $2B48.
